title: 2026 United States House of Representatives Election in Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District
description: Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District will elect a U.S. Representative on November 3, 2026. The district, which covers the eastern portion of the state including Providence, Pawtucket, and East Providence, is heavily Democratic (D+78.8 by 2024 presidential results). Incumbent Democrat Gabe Amo, who won a 2023 special election and a full term in 2024, is seeking re-election. Republican Kellie Keenan and Independent Wilfred Curioso have filed to challenge him. The race is considered safe for Democrats, but the primary and general election will test whether Republican messaging on costs and government efficiency can gain traction in a deep-blue district.

candidates.name: Gabe Amo
candidates.summary: Gabe Amo is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District, first elected in a November 2023 special election and re-elected to a full term in 2024. A Pawtucket native and son of Ghanaian and Liberian immigrants, he previously served as a Special Assistant to President Biden and Deputy Director of the White House Office of Intergovernmental Affairs. Amo emphasizes his experience in federal government and focus on economic opportunity, healthcare access, and climate resilience for Rhode Island.

candidates.name: Kellie Keenan
candidates.summary: Kellie Keenan is a Republican candidate for Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District. Her campaign emphasizes lowering costs for working families, cutting government waste and bureaucracy, increasing transparency, and focusing on practical policy solutions over partisan politics. She has a background in public administration and positions herself as a 'common sense candidate' focused on Rhode Island-first priorities including infrastructure, energy costs, housing affordability, and small business support.

candidates.summary: Wilfred Curioso is an Independent candidate who filed a statement of candidacy with the FEC on April 24, 2025, for Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District. He is listed as a challenger with no prior federal office experience. Limited public information is available about his background, platform, or campaign organization.

forecast.rationale: Rhode Island's 1st Congressional District is overwhelmingly Democratic (D+78.8 by 2024 presidential results). Incumbent Democrat Gabe Amo won both the 2023 special election and a full 2024 term without serious challenge. The Republican challenger, Kellie Keenan, has generated limited public traction, and Independent Wilfred Curioso has scant public profile or campaign infrastructure. With zero polling available to measure current dynamics, confidence is capped at medium. However, the structural partisan lean, incumbency advantage, and absence of any strong contrary signal point to an overwhelming Democratic advantage well above the 95% threshold for a safe rating.
